target_customer: General contractors, subcontractors, owners and design professionals in construction
problem: Discrepancies between specs, drawings, geotechnical studies and contracts become costly rework or claims. Telamont reads all project documents together and flags risks, then tracks them to resolution.
product_category: AI construction document and contract risk detection

founders.name: Charles Goulet
founders.background_notes: YC page says he is from a third-generation construction family.

competitors.name: Document Crunch
competitors.what: Construction contract compliance and risk platform

competitors.name: InspectMind AI
competitors.what: AI checker for construction drawings, specs and codes (YC)

competitors.name: BuildCheck
competitors.what: Computer vision checks of construction drawings
competitors.traction_then: over 110 paying customers per a funding report

competitors.name: Trunk Tools
competitors.what: Cortex AI platform interpreting drawings, RFIs, specs

technical_complexity.rationale: Cross-document reasoning over drawings, specs and contracts with integrations to Procore, Autodesk and SharePoint is hard, but current LLMs make it tractable for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and accumulated project history help, but several funded competitors do similar document checking.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to say; platform vendors and funded startups already work on the same wedge.

market_need_then: The YC description cites seven-figure claims arising from missed discrepancies; many funded 2025 and 2026 startups target the same pain, which shows demand.

identity.logo: Navy and blue logo with a white symbol version
identity.visual_style: Photos of workers in hard hats, numbered steps, bold short headings

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive name close to Telamon, Telmont and Telamont-like names, with no press about the brand; construction imagery fits the audience.

outcome_analysis: Telamont joined YC in Fall 2026 from Quebec City with founders who combine a construction family background and software engineering, and customer logos on its site. No outcome exists yet; the main risk is a crowded field of funded document-checking startups and construction platform vendors.
notes: Slashdot lists founding 2025; not confirmed by a primary source so founded_year is null. Dealroom shows a seed stage with hidden amount; not recorded as a round. Quebec City location comes from a third-party summary while YC lists San Francisco. The company is in YC Fall 2026 per YC page; one search summary said no source mentioned YC, but the YC page and site both do.
